newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cupertino USD, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cupertino USD, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
Current Interest Bonds and Capital Appreciation Bonds
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Cupertino Union School District (the District''), in Santa Clara County,
California, intends to offer for public sale on

at the offices of Brown & Wood LLP, 555 California Street, 50th Floor, San Francisco, California 94104, facsimile number (415) 397-4621, $27,000,000* principal amount of general obligation bonds of the District designated

Cupertino Union School District, Santa Clara County, California 1997 General Obligation Bonds (Election of 1995, Series B)'' (the Bonds''). The Bonds will be comprised of Current Interest Bonds and Capital Appreciation Bonds. The District intends to accept bids for the Current Interest Bonds at 10:00 a.m., local time, and to accept bids for the Capital Appreciation Bonds at 10:30 a.m., local time. Fax bids will be accepted.
Within 26 hours, the Santa Clara County Director of Finance, or his designee, in conjunction with the

Superintendent or Assistant Superintendent of the District, or the designee of either such officer, will consider the bids received and, if an acceptable bid is received, award the sale of the Bonds on the basis of the true interest cost. In the event that no bid is awarded by the designated time, the District will reschedule the sale to another date or time by providing notification through Munifacts News Service. The District reserves the right to change the time or postpone the date of the sale to any other time or date by providing notification through Munifacts News Service.

NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of separate Notices Inviting Proposals for Purchase of Bonds for the Current Interest Bonds and the Capital Appreciation Bonds. An Official Statement and the Notices Inviting Proposals for Purchase of Bonds will be furnished upon request to Kelling, Northcross & Nobriga, 1333 Broadway, Oakland, California 94612, (510) 839-8200, the financial consultants to the District for the Bonds.
